responsibility: This target header defines bare-metal ELF driver and linker specs for AArch64 configurations that do not use an operating-system-specific runtime wrapper. It selects startup and termination files such as crt0/crti/crtbegin/crtend/crtn, provides a raw ELF LINK_SPEC with ABI and endianness selection, and appends erratum-related linker options so that freestanding AArch64 builds get the correct runtime objects and linker emulation.
